newsitem.title: USA: Sun Television to open about 10 stores.
newsitem.headline: Sun Television to open about 10 stores.

text.p: Sun Television and Appliances Inc said Monday it plans to open as many as 10 new stores before the holiday season as part of a new strategic direction.
The company said the new stores will target rural markets in Ohio, Pennsylvania, West Virginia and Kentucky and are part of its overall turnaround strategy.
The company said the strategy follows a review of its individual store performance and is part of a new store format it believes will position it to return to profitability.

The planned expansion calls for stores ranging in size from 16,000 to 23,000 square feet in markets with populations of 100,000 to 150,000. It said the cost of opening and maintaining these stores should be significantly lower than its traditional superstores, thereby improving return on investment.

The company said cash from a successful $20 million sale leaseback of its Columbus, Ohio, facility and operating and expense improvements made during the year gives it the cash flow needed for its plan.
The company said it will release further details at its annual shareholder meeting on Tuesday, July 22.
